title: Underground Water Resource
definition: Underground water resources encompass all water found beneath the land surface in the pore spaces of soils and in the fractures of lithologic formations (groundwater), sustained by hydrological recharge and serving as the largest accessible reservoir of fresh water on Earth.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (geomorphology, hydrogeology, government schemes like Atal Bhujal Yojana, CGWB reports) and Mains GS-1 (water resource geography) & GS-3 (irrigation, agricultural crises, environmental degradation, water security).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Underground Water Resource.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
